answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in relic, expire in thread, and ridge lists each expiry. An attacker running 40 aliases therefore needs 193 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3298 identities would post 2903 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
